name: video-gallery
title: Video Gallery
description: A dark portfolio section lists video projects as image cards with category tags, search and filters. Hovering reveals a title and play action; clicking opens a modal player with details and specs.
use: A filmmaker, studio or videographer needs a full portfolio section that leads from browsing to playback.
avoid: Pages with no media to fill it, since the section depends on real footage and several large remote videos.
a11y: Cards are mouse-only click targets and several icon buttons rely on title text, so the lightbox is hard to reach; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black page opens with a large white Featured Videos heading, a search button and five filter pills above a grid of video thumbnails carrying small uppercase tags. Cards are dark and rounded with white type.
behaves: Filter pills and search narrow the grid with an animated reflow, and cards lift and zoom on hover to reveal a dark gradient, title and View Project button. Clicking a card opens a full-screen player with arrows, share and fullscreen controls.
customise: Projects, categories and all their copy live in arrays inside the file, so changes mean editing source. There are no content props and the dark palette is fixed.
weight: moderate: A few dozen animated nodes and remote thumbnails; one video plays at a time.
demo: Featured Videos heading and projects such as Cinematic Journey, Northern Passage and Tuscany Wedding Trailer
issues: Project cards are divs with no tab stop, so keyboard users cannot open the lightbox.
All five projects and their remote video URLs are hardcoded inside the file.
polishWhy: Cohesive dark portfolio with clean filters and a strong hover card; stock imagery holds it back.
